description: A huge grown elephant with long curved white tusks and big ears walks across a dry golden savanna at sunset. Right beside its front legs trots a tiny baby elephant, lifting its short trunk and kicking up dust. The big elephant swings its trunk down and gently touches the baby's back as they walk on together. The grass is tall and pale, flat-topped acacia trees stand behind them and low hills fade into the warm orange haze of the evening sky.

en.question: What is the adult elephant doing?

de.answer: Er streichelt den Rücken des Kalbs.
de.question: Was macht der erwachsene Elefant?

es.answer: Está acariciando el lomo de la cría.
